announcements.headline: dorsaVi v6.5 Sensor Advances Physical AI Strategy
summary: dorsaVi's v6.5 sensor release signals a deliberate pivot toward Physical AI — the integration of real-world motion data with AI inference — positioning the company in a high-growth intersection of wearables, biomechanics, and industrial AI that could attract new enterprise and defence customers beyond its traditional clinical base.

The upgrade's commercial significance hinges on whether v6.5 drives meaningful uplift in recurring SaaS/subscription revenue or accelerates new contract wins; with dorsaVi historically cash-constrained (sub-$2M cash in recent quarters), any hardware-led refresh cycle must convert quickly to ARR to avoid near-term dilution risk.

Key near-term catalysts to watch: customer adoption announcements, partnership or OEM deals leveraging the new sensor stack, and whether the 'Physical AI' narrative attracts strategic interest from larger industrial or healthcare technology players — making the next quarterly (4C) a critical validation point for this strategic repositioning.

announcements.headline: First Diamond Drill Hole Assays 50.9M at 2.81% Cu
summary: The maiden diamond drill hole at White Cliff's copper project has returned a headline intercept of 50.9m at 2.81% Cu — a high-grade, wide intersection that materially de-risks the project and validates the geological model; 2.81% copper is well above typical open-pit economic thresholds (~0.3–0.5%) and competitive with top-tier underground deposits globally.

The combination of exceptional grade and significant width in the very first drill hole signals potential for a substantial copper mineralised system; at current copper prices (~USD 4.40/lb), this intercept carries strong in-situ value optionality and is likely to attract institutional and strategic investor attention to a small-cap explorer.

Near-term catalysts are compelling: remaining drill holes from the current program are pending assay, and a positive follow-up program is highly probable — investors should watch for step-out drilling results, resource estimation timelines, and any potential farm-in or JV interest given the scale of the initial hit.
